newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp B jumps 5.66 pct on buying.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp B jumps 5.66 pct on buying.

text.p: Ayala Corp B shares rose by 5.66 percent to 28 pesos in early Thursday trade on the Philippine Stock Exchange on perceptions the conglomerate had been oversold, brokers said.
The stock was up 1.50 pesos from the previous close of 26.50 pesos.
Investors snapping at Ayala Corp B shares indicate that foreign funds are starting to come in, Spencer Yap, analyst at BPI Capital Corp said.
Yap said investors may also be cheered by hopes of strong third quarter earnings by the company.
A total of 408,000 Ayala Corp B shares changed hands in early trade.
